recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not edit checked-in/generated diagram artifacts for this issue unless future generated output demonstrates a current link defect.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive auto-approved FHIR-core DSTU2 issue reporting that generated allTypes diagram links to Duration, Age, and other Quantity specializations were broken because they used lower-case fragments instead of upper-case type anchors.
initial_application: Jira records a 2017-02-27 comment that the issue had been fixed. No explicit current git commit message with FHIR-12805 was found, consistent with older tracker/SVN-era fixes not always carrying the later Jira key.
additional_context: FHIR-13241 later addressed the same Quantity anchor/link family and was applied by changing lower-case Duration links to datatypes.html#Duration. source/fhir.ini actively includes alltypes=datatypes/alltypes.diagram and the Quantity specialization types.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/datatypes/alltypes.diagram and source/datatypes/types.diagram list the Quantity specializations with canonical uppercase type names, and source/datatypes.html exposes matching uppercase anchors.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue and applied commit for the same Quantity specialization anchor/link family.
